description: Lease outlay over the lease term versus buy outlay net of equity in the car at the same point, with the winning option and the net cost difference. Use when the user compares leasing a car against buying it. For loan-only figures use calculate_auto_loan. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive lease vs buy calculator.

buy_down_payment.description: Buy down payment in USD; default 0.

lease_down_payment.description: Lease down payment in USD; default 0.

money_factor.description: Lease money factor, for example 0.0025; default 0.

residual_pct.description: Residual value as a percent of MSRP at lease end.

name: calculate_lease_vs_buy

calculator_url.description: Deep link to the matching interactive calculator on everycalc.xyz.

inputs.description: The normalized inputs the calculation used.

results.description: The computed figures for this calculator.

tool.description: Name of the tool that ran.
